title: Handloom Worsted Rafal Shawls and Lohis (Amalgamating IS 1268)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes constructional particulars and other requirements for ten varieties of handloom worsted rafal shawls and lohis. 1.2 This standard does not specify the general appearance, feel, etc, of the material.
